_comment: PlantVision 1.1 — 10 houseplant disease classes. Stage 1 detector is single-class (leaf); the disease decision is owned by Stage 2. Pests (spider_mites/aphids/mealybug/scale_insect/whitefly) are NOT classifier outputs — they appear as 'possible_pest_causes' hints per disease (see server/diseases_data.py PEST_INFO). Order matches sorted(ImageFolder.classes), i.e. alphabetical. EfficientNet-B0 @ 240 is the production primary; an optional EfficientNetV2-S @ 300 ensemble peer is loaded when classifier_v2s*.onnx is present. This file is regenerated automatically by the final cell of train_notebook.ipynb after each training run; the values below are defaults that match the notebook.

training.cutmix_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
training.mixup_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
training._note: Real values overwritten by the final cell of train_notebook.ipynb after each run.

ensemble._note: Loaded only if classifier_v2s*.onnx is present next to the primary checkpoint.
